generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Period for completion of this work is 3(three) months including Monsoon

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2023-24 CONTINUED FOR 2026-27 and prevailing GST (18% of Amount Put to tender) amount is kept in form of Lump sum in sanctioned estimate according to guidelines in Common SR 2023-24(As per circular from Govt. of Karnataka no.12/2024 Bangaluru Dt:09.08.2024). Therefore, amount put to Tender and ECV amount are excluding GST. KPPP-PORTAL format has No Options to add GST Separately at stage of Draft Tender Schedule Process for Over All amount put to Tender, tender has been inviting through an Option with INCLUSIVE. But the item wise rates do not include GST. Hence, GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly. Hence the bidder has to quote the rate exclusive of GST and to submit a declaration which is duly signed by the bidder along with their tender proposal.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public procurement portal
Royalty on construction materials and other applicable taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

The tenderer should be a PWD registered Contractor - Class-3 and above also Contractors should have Registration of GST, Employers Provident Fund and tenderer should submit Registration Certificate along with technical bid.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incidents happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

The item rates quoted shall include cost of royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per the rates provided in prevailing cost & conveyance of all materials, Curing, Watering, unloading with all leads & lifts labor, hire charges of machinery equipment etc., complete including all incidental charges. All the items shall beexecuted as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work.
Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the concerned Executive Engineer, PWD Division, during office hours on all working days.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act.
The Tenderer should furnish all the necessary original documents mentioned above to the Executive engineer
The intending bidders are requested to note that they should abide by the instructions and conditions contained in the bid documents and further orders thereon.
Contractor has to upload the valid EPF registration copy.

The successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty Charges. The Contractor has to submit MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise Department will take necessary action as per the Government Orders/Circulars.
Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD.300.LET.2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW.134.BMS.2007 dated 27.07.2007 a sum amounting to 1Percent of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.
The tenderer should maintain the work during the Defects liability period upto 31.08.2027
Materials like bitumen steel cement etc required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work
The successful bidder shall achieve the pothole free road within 2 months fromthe date of site possession for the safe and convenient public road transport

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The Tender should have a valid KPWD Registered Class-IV and Above contractor.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 3.2a achieved in at least TWO financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. 5.08 Lakhs, in all classes of Civil Engineering Construction works only Balance sheet & Profit & Loss Account indicating contract receipts issued by the competent accountant / Authority with UDIN number

To qualify for Award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 3.2bsatisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Road Maintenance work of value not less than Rs. 2.54 lakhs. Work done Certificate issued by competent Authority of rank not less than Executive Engineer

Statement indicating the A.Existig commitments and ongoing works, B.Details of works for which tenders are already submitted. The statements should furnished as per statement 1.5 A,B of Section 3 of Qualification information in Standard Bid document.
Name, address, and telephone, telex, and fax numbers of the Tenderers may provide references if contacted by the Employer.
